changed: Context ablation, first fixture run (research 03 §8): design evals/ablation/context-history-vs-typed.md (hypotheses, metrics, corpus, threats, limits); scripts/context_ablation.py runs the release-report fixture corpus with context_assembler off and on, reusing release_report; evals/reports/phase3-context-ablation.json labelled fixture evidence, deterministic. Result: 21/21 cases both arms, 17 verified and 4 failed in each, repair rate 0.3824 in each, 72 packs and 0 fallbacks in on, pack tokens 53216 (kernel estimate), 0 evidence dropped or masked; model tokens unknown. This shows only that on does not change the host path; the scripted driver never reads its context, so it says nothing about typed state helping a model. D3-31: the repair-rate numerator is the kernel's own counter (the stored continuation's repairs); terminal refusals are one per run FAILED validation_failed or verification_failed; policy_denied is its own key; the denominator is repairs + validated attempts + terminal, so the rate is at most 1. Baseline evals/reports/phase3-baseline.json regenerated: repair rate 0.4706 -> 0.3824 (13/34). The on arm reads context.assembled (plan Interfaces line updated). Commits aa14ce3, fd5d820, c33feb2, b5e8b7a; reviews harness/state/3/reviews/3f.2-r1.json, 3f.2-r2.json (rework), 3f.2-r3.json (accept).

rulings.ruling: The repair-rate numerator is the kernel's own counter read from the stored continuation, not re-derived from events (after two review rounds found missed increment sites).
A refusal is terminal only by the run's FAILED reason code; policy_denied is reported separately.
